headline: Columbarium presentation, a $500 DAR donation, Second Parish headstone payment, and cemetery repair and safety reports.
summary: The meeting will cover a Second Parish headstone payment, citizen reports on overgrowth and tree safety, and a First Parish sign repair. It will also include a columbarium presentation and a review of cemetery safety.
